crossRefs.note: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,

people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
translations.bsb: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
translations.kjv: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
translations.asv: The voice of Jehovah breaketh the cedars; Yea, Jehovah breaketh in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
